title: Insights Library
meta_description: Perspectives across eight deep-tech domains — retrieval economics, agentic policy, PQC clocks, provenance compliance and more.

blocks.x: Viewpoints from the delivery floor — what shipped, what scaled, what stalled, and what we would do differently.
Every insight takes a position, shows where it breaks in practice, and names the discipline that keeps it honest. Where a claim depends on a client number, the engagement note behind it is linked.
Start with the category that matches the decision on your desk, or the article closest to the argument you are having internally.
Disagree with any of it? Good — the briefing exists for exactly that argument.
